answer: One concrete defense is bonded, slashable stake paired with behavioral correlation. Every agent locks a stake before trading; each identity's action pattern becomes an ember-like fingerprint. If two identities match too closely — basalt-hard proof one operator runs both — both stakes are slashed. Running 100 sybils then costs 100 stakes instead of zero, and the slashed funds cedar-feed a reporter reward. Attacker cost scales per identity; honest agents pay once.
